scientific.integrity: The proof reconstructs the conditional Dirichlet gap law, its second moment, the Poisson index-shift identity, the integral evaluation, and positivity of the closed form. A standalone checker independently replays conditional identities and direct Poisson summations; computation is supplementary rather than a substitute for proof.
scientific.limitations: Exact only for a homogeneous Poisson process on a finite interval with both boundary gaps included and the population-variance convention for gap dispersion. No theorem is asserted for general renewal processes, omitted boundary gaps, or completed-interarrival-only statistics. The unavailable full Di–Perlman journal body and older alternate-normalization spacing literature remain residual originality risks.

title: Poisson gap normalization reverses covariance with the event count
